title: Anti-automation verification
description: Contract "Anti-automation" between the frontend, the backend and Google reCAPTCHA v2 (SR-01, SR-02). Mode recaptcha: the frontend renders the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget with the site key from /api/form-config and sends its response token as captchaToken; the backend sends `request` as application/x-www-form-urlencoded with HTTP POST to the configured verification URL (default https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify) and accepts the registration only when `response.success` is true. A non-2xx answer, a timeout or an unparsable body is not a success: the registration is answered with 503 and nothing is stored. Mode test: no network call; the frontend shows a plain checkbox that yields the token in `testMode.passToken`; the backend accepts exactly that token and rejects every other value.

request.description: Form fields of the verification call. remoteip is never sent (data minimisation, SB-12).
